name: smwpatches-bullet-bill-sound-effect-on-extra-bit
title: Bullet Bill Sound Effect on Extra Bit
description:
This patch will enable placed Bullet Bills to play a sound effect, when spawned, if their extra bit is set in Lunar Magic (opposed to being silent as usual).

Use as an alternative to No Silent Bullet Bill as they are not compatible.

Moderation note: Pixi must be installed for this to work.
